detours: Bow_Short78309 spawned Poor then Set quality Normal.
Gun_MachinePistol78310 spawned Excellent with generated art then Set quality Normal; retained art is not player-crafted evidence.
Revolver-equipped/ready and Machine-held/ready filenames are early walking states; actual equipment IDs decide completion.

Target became Manhunter after the first left-revolver hit and again during machine-pistol burst. Dev Stop mental state at144319 prepares the next sample;144413 stops further combat during cleanup. Wounds and prior saves are retained.
Two foreground guard rejections sent no input. Existing native-window capture restored the same window at06:35:24Z; no process launch/reload.

ui.source: Manual reading of original screenshots, not OCR or injected labels.

clock.note: Pulse wall-clock durations include input dispatch overhead; saved game ticks are authoritative. Requested speed3 did not establish its nominal multiplier. Each bounded run ends with one pause click and equal-tick double save; cleanup performs no pause toggle.

Same bow after Dev Set quality Normal: HP100,Damage11,AP16%,range23,accuracy75/65/45/25%,aim1.35s,cooldown1.65s.
Dev Spawn thing produced Excellent Machine pistol with generated art; distinct from ordinary crafting.
Same Machine pistol after Dev Set quality Normal:HP100,Damage6,AP9%,range20,burst3,514.29rpm,aim0.5s,cooldown0.90s.
Fresh Dev-spawned Muffalo78311: female age12, no health conditions, listed capacities100%.
Grump has inherited Neck Bite scar; overall Healthy does not mean full capacities: consciousness95%,manipulation95%,moving90%,breathing73%,sight100%.
Ordinary forced attack targeting the Muffalo; no Dev damage.
Paused ordinary left-revolver firing scene. Raw save separately establishes projectile and cooldown; screenshot alone is not a field trace.
Original target health after Revolver impact; detailed injury linked to raw Gunshot143/Log44.
Ordinary Equip machine pistol option, while drafted with Fire at will off.
Paused MachinePistol first-shot scene. Bursting2/next2 is established by corresponding original save, not visual inference.
Paused scene corresponding to all three live projectile records in original save144394.
Four ordinary Gunshots: revolver rear-left leg; machine-pistol rear-right leg,jaw,body. Bleeding82%/d; capacities shown by UI.
Original combat log links the weapon fire and four hit descriptions.
Explicit Dev Stop mental state cleanup; this is not natural recovery.
Final equal double save at144413; no blind pause toggle during cleanup.

limitations: Only one Revolver attack and one MachinePistol burst; all four happened to injure the target. This is not a hit-rate, hit-location distribution, armor/AP, cover or frequency estimate.

Fresh target preparation and two Stop mental state interventions are explicit. MachinePistol uses the already injured target at a shorter distance; these are not matched damage/accuracy comparison groups.
Short bow has only original UI observations; no arrow-flight or ordinary bow-shot observation. Autopistol was not used as a burst weapon.

Actual MachinePistol projectile spawnedTick intervals are6,7 in this sample although XML ticksBetweenBurstShots is7. Chapter57 provides separate static call-order evidence for same-tick scheduling; the saves alone establish timings, not internal callbacks.
Projectile origin includes saved y=8.4126215. Travel observations are27ticks for this revolver shot and17ticks for each machine bullet; no universal speed or 2D travel formula is inferred.
Grump has an inherited Neck scar with reduced capacities despite Healthy label. Skills, health and apparel were not reset to ideal values.

The target acquired BloodLoss naturally and re-entered Manhunter. Final cleanup ends mental state without healing; Grump retains a FleeAndCower job created on undrafting, with no active attack and no further simulation.
Some snapshot filenames anticipate equipment completion. Retain them unchanged and inspect actual equipment owner/job: revolver-held-b and machine-equipped-b are the completed pickups.
No wall/sandbag runtime comparison, projectile cover interception, line-of-sight failure or prone-target experiment was executed. Static57 remains the evidence for those mechanisms.

Raw saves/full captures stay in ignored local research storage. Portable verification checks retained data, identities, field consistency and image hashes; local mode rereads original files. Neither mode replays combat, performs OCR or establishes unseen RNG outcomes.
